notes.title: Patch notes for July 18th
notes.notes:
It's finally time for old toys to get new upgrades!

Here's the list of what this patch contains:

Minor spellcheck and grammar fixes 

Fixed a problem where some renders were not appearing 

Fixed a bug where Lexi's scene was not obtainable 

Added a default image for the new main menu wishlist ad to avoid having no image when there's no internet connection 

Other minor bugfixes and corrections

Best regards,
Inceton Games

notes.title: Update notes
notes.notes:
Fixed the Gallery that's unlocked after completing the game.
Fixed an issue where MacOS users couldn't start the game (hopefully...)
Other minor spelling and grammar fixes
